checkpoint: CLEAN CLONE BUILD RECOVERY - MuPDF route bundling + repository normalization

rootCause.disproofEvidence: The original repository whose build was verified green locks the SAME mupdf 1.28.0 and emitted a 52KB mupdf route with 0 WASM inlines and 0 .pnpm paths. Identical version builds green under npm and failed under pnpm.
actualRootCause: mupdf 1.28.0 is an ESM package (type:module) that boots WASM via top-level await. Webpack bundling produced a CJS interop shim -> ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE, surfacing as 'TypeError: a is not a function'.

The app reached mupdf only through workspace package design-build-extraction-mupdf, which is in transpilePackages. Next transpiled it and followed the 'mupdf' import edge, overriding serverExternalPackages and inlining the WASM bootstrap plus a machine-specific .pnpm file:// URL into the route chunk, which was then evaluated during page-data collection.
Phantom dependency: /api/extraction/ai imports 'mupdf' directly but the app never declared it. Under npm's flat node_modules it resolved via hoisting; under pnpm's isolated store it did not.

mupdfVersion.reason: 1.28.0 is the version used by the last verified green build (original repository package-lock.json + successful .next/BUILD_ID). 1.25.x was never validated by any green build, so downgrading would have been an unjustified change. Caret removed so future installs cannot drift.
